metadata.title: AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CERTAIN ADMINISTRATION AND ENFORCEMENT PROVISIONS OF ARTICLE XI OF ORDINANCE NO. 8119, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE MANILA COMPREHENSIVE LAND USE PLAN AND ZONING ORDINANCE OF 2006[cite: 1]
principal_authors: HON. MARLON M. LACSON, Majority Floor Leader[cite: 1]

sections.amends: Section 63, Article XI of Ordinance No. 8119, otherwise known as the Manila Comprehensive Land Use Plan and Zoning Ordinance of 2006[cite: 1]
sections.section_title: SEC. 63. ISSUANCE OF ZONING PERMIT (LOCATIONAL CLEARANCE) AND SPECIAL USE PERMITS.[cite: 1]
sections.content: All lot/land owners/land developers and business establishments shall secure a zoning permit (locational clearance) from the City Planning and Development Officer for all conforming uses.[cite: 1] All applications for the issuance of the special use permit for all conforming uses, regardless on whether it is a new application or a renewal thereof, shall be forwarded by the City Planning and Development Officer to the Sangguniang Panlungsod through the Committee on Housing, Urban Development and Resettlement.[cite: 1] No special use permits as provided for under Section 52 hereof shall be issued by the City Planning and Development Officer unless and until a resolution approving the application mentioned in the preceding paragraph is issued by the Sangguniang Panlungsod.[cite: 1] In cases of applications for variances and exceptions, the resolution approving the zoning permit or special use permit shall be issued by the Sangguniang Panlungsod only upon recommendation of the Manila Zoning Board of adjustment Appeals (MZBAA) through the Committee on Housing, Urban Development and Resettlement.[cite: 1]

sections.amends: Section 64, Article XI of Ordinance No. 8119, otherwise known as the Manila Comprehensive Land Use Plan and Zoning Ordinance of 2006[cite: 1]
sections.section_title: SEC. 64. PERIOD OF ZONING PERMIT/SPECIAL USE PERMIT'S APPROVAL/DISAPPROVAL.[cite: 1]
sections.content: The approval/disapproval of the zoning permit shall not be withheld for more than thirty (30) days from receipt of the application except those provided for under Section 60 (Deviations) hereof, in which case, said period shall not exceed sixty (60) days.[cite: 1] A special use permit shall be issued by the City Planning and Development Officer within ten (10) days from receipt of the resolution approving the same issued by the Sangguniang Panlungsod as mentioned in the preceding section.[cite: 1]

The issuance of the Special Use Permit under Section 1 hereof shall be a condition sine qua non for the issuance of the business permit of those covered under Section 52 of Ordinance No. 8119.[cite: 1]

If, for any reason or reasons, any part or provision of this Ordinance shall be held unconstitutional or invalid, other parts or provision hereof, which are not affected thereby, shall contunue to be in full force and effect.[cite: 1]
This Ordinance shall take effect upon its approval.[cite: 1]
